observations.braam: Integrated as a harmonic extension of low brass and percussion; visceral cinematic impact without masking orchestral space.
observations.ping: Organic high-frequency punctuation with diffuse tail and no generic-bank harshness.
observations.orchestral_integration: Hybrid sound-design textures merge coherently with VSCO and Salamander acoustic timbres without audible seams.
observations.global_production: Result presents a coherent trailer/film-score post-production language and passed the human perceptual gate.
